blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office continues to turn its commitment to public service into meaningful action through the PCSO Charity Run, an initiative that brings people together through sports while promoting the spirit of generosity and compassion for Filipinos in need. Held on October 18, 2026, at Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati City, the agency’s third Charity Run gathered families, friends, and even young people across the 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21K race categories. This event was part of the agency’s activities in line with the celebration of National Day of Charity, which is celebrated annually on October 30, as declared […]...
